description: Edit fields of a GENERATION's output (a saved library item), e.g. fix a name or rewrite a backstory. Pass changes as {field_path: new value} using paths from chargen_get_generation's output (dots and [index] for lists, e.g. "inventory[2].name"). Paths must already exist. Requires a plan above Basic. Concurrent edits in the app can race this tool (last write wins). For campaign-tracked entities use chargen_update_entity instead. Generation library items are public by default, so edits may be visible in public CharGen browsing; visibility can be changed in CharGen.

changes.description: Map of field_path -> new value, e.g. {"personality": "kindly", "quirks[1]": "whistles"}

name: chargen_update_generation
title: Edit generation
